title: Sport
description: Name the things you play sport with, and talk about a match.
grammar: gender and articles, and regular -ar verbs
grammarNote: The words for sport are ordinary nouns, and most of the verbs are -ar verbs.

explanation.summary: Sport has its own nouns and its own verbs, and the grammar is the one you already know. What is new is the vocabulary.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El gimnasio, el equipo, el juego, el descanso and el marcador are masculine. La cancha, la raqueta, la pelota y la entrada are feminine. La cancha is the court or the pitch, and el marcador is the score.

sections.heading: The verbs
sections.body: Sport is full of -ar verbs, and they work exactly like the ones you know: juego, juegas, juega. Ganar is to win, and perder is to lose, but ganar is regular: gano, ganas, gana.

examples.es: el descanso es a las cuatro

items.note: A regular -ar verb: gano, ganas, gana.
Feminine: la entrada. It is also the ticket you pay for.

drills.meaning: the score is two to one
